document.name: DialogsFixture
document.documentation:
Kitchen Sink fixture for server-side questions (EXT.getDialogs()).
Its actions, Bizlet and view ask a question from each kind of request that can ask: custom actions, OK and Save (preSave), Delete (preDelete), a rerender from a field change, a server action in a change handler, and ZoomOut (and, in PrimeFaces, Remove) of a row. Outcome records what the code did after the questions were answered.

text.name: text
text.description: Changing it rerenders the view, and the rerender asks whether to carry on with the change logic.

text.name: actionText
text.description: Changing it runs the Ask Once action from its change handler.

boolean.name: askOnSave
boolean.description: When ticked, preSave asks whether to save.

boolean.name: askOnDelete
boolean.description: When ticked, preDelete asks whether to delete.

text.name: outcome
text.description: What the code did after its questions were answered.

collection.name: rows
collection.description: Zooming out of a row asks first, as does removing a row in PrimeFaces.
